rows.section: Personal income tax (impozitul pe venit, art. 64 and art. 78)
rows.basis: Taxable salary income per month: gross pay less CAS, CASS and the personal deduction
rows.note: A flat 10% applies to the income categories listed in art. 64 (salaries, self-employment, rent, pensions and others) unless the Code sets a specific rate (16% on dividends). On salaries it is a final monthly tax withheld by the employer; voluntary pension contributions (up to EUR 400 a year) and union dues are also deducted from the base.
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 64 and art. 78

rows.section: Personal deduction (deducere personală, art. 77)
rows.label: Who can claim the base deduction
rows.value: Employees at their main place of work with gross monthly pay up to the minimum wage + RON 2,000
rows.basis: Share of the gross minimum wage in force in the month, per month
rows.note: The deduction is limited to the month's taxable income. The amounts in RON are the percentages applied to the minimum wage of the period (RON 4,050 to June, RON 4,325 from July 2026); the full table by pay band is below.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa (viză de lungă ședere pentru alte scopuri, D/AS)
rows.value: Remote employees of a foreign company or owners of a foreign company held for at least 3 years, working through information and communication technology; 90-day long-stay visa, then a temporary residence permit marked 'nomad digital'
rows.note: Contribution bases use the RON 4,050 minimum wage in force on 1 January 2026; self-employed pensioners do not owe CAS.
rows.source_title: IGI (General Inspectorate for Immigration): Ordonanța de urgență nr. 194/2002 privind regimul străinilor în România, republished, consolidated form valid on 30 April 2026, art. 2 lit. n^4), art. 24, art. 30 alin. (7), art. 49 alin. (1) lit. f^1) and (2^1), art. 69

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa: income requirement
rows.value: At least 3× the average gross monthly earnings in Romania for each of the last 6 months and for the whole visa period
rows.note: Contribution bases use the RON 4,050 minimum wage in force on 1 January 2026; self-employed pensioners do not owe CAS.
rows.source_title: IGI (General Inspectorate for Immigration): Ordonanța de urgență nr. 194/2002 privind regimul străinilor în România, republished, consolidated form valid on 30 April 2026, art. 2 lit. n^4), art. 24, art. 30 alin. (7), art. 49 alin. (1) lit. f^1) and (2^1), art. 69

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa: residence extension
rows.value: First extension 6 months; further extensions with income still at 3× the average gross earnings and an income certificate from the tax authority; medical insurance of at least EUR 30,000
rows.note: Contribution bases use the RON 4,050 minimum wage in force on 1 January 2026; self-employed pensioners do not owe CAS.
rows.source_title: IGI (General Inspectorate for Immigration): Ordonanța de urgență nr. 194/2002 privind regimul străinilor în România, republished, consolidated form valid on 30 April 2026, art. 2 lit. n^4), art. 24, art. 30 alin. (7), art. 49 alin. (1) lit. f^1) and (2^1), art. 69

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa: tax consequence
rows.value: Salary from the foreign employer is not taxable in Romania and no pension or health contributions are due while the nomad is present no more than 183 days in any 12 consecutive months; beyond that the person becomes resident and is taxed normally
rows.note: Contribution bases use the RON 4,050 minimum wage in force on 1 January 2026; self-employed pensioners do not owe CAS.
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 228 lit. d), art. 136 lit. b) and art. 7 pct. 28

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: Visa: a Romanian embassy or consulate, with the approval of the National Visa Centre after the opinion of the General Inspectorate for Immigration (IGI); residence permit and extensions: the IGI
rows.note: Contribution bases use the RON 4,050 minimum wage in force on 1 January 2026; self-employed pensioners do not owe CAS.
